cand.intro: Follow your recruitment after the CBT: document verification, medical examination, panel, offer and joining. Download your letters and raise a grievance.
cand.n.dv: Report at {t} to {v}. Bring the original documents listed in your e-call letter and your Aadhaar card.
cand.n.esc: Your document verification is under review by the Member Secretary. You will be informed of the decision.
cand.n.fit: You are medically fit ({s}). The final result and panels will be published after all candidates complete DV and medical examination.
cand.n.joined: You joined {u} on {d}. Employee ID {id}. Welcome to Indian Railways.
cand.n.med: Report at 08:00 to {h} with the medical memo and your Aadhaar card. Come fasting; bring spectacles if you use them.
cand.n.off: Report by {d} with your original documents.
cand.n.panel: You are empanelled for {p}. Your offer of appointment will come from the Railway unit you are allotted to.
cand.n.rec: Your documents were verified. You will be referred for medical examination shortly.
cand.n.result: Results are declared. You are not in the current DV list; additional candidates are called in merit order if places remain.
cand.n.short: You are shortlisted for document verification. Your DV date and e-call letter will be published here and sent by SMS.
cand.n.temp: You were found temporarily unfit. You will be called for re-examination by {d}.
cand.n.withheld: Your candidature is on hold pending verification. The RRB will contact you; you can raise a grievance if you need clarification.
cand.raised: Grievance {id} registered. We reply within 48 hours.
cand.sent: OTP sent to your registered mobile {m}. Demo: the OTP is {o}.
cand.sla: We reply within 48 hours. You can follow the reply here and by SMS.
cand.title: Candidate sign-in

eca.copies: Copies delivered to Nodal RRB ({n}) on {a} and RRB/SC on {b}.
eca.r1: Only the RRB (dealing assistant or Member Secretary) can start an outbound transfer; every step is written to the activity log.
eca.r2: Files are encrypted with the ECA public key before transfer and are never sent over e-mail.
eca.r3: ECA must acknowledge with the same SHA-256 checksum; a mismatch blocks the CEN until the file is re-sent.
eca.r4: The result file from ECA is imported and validated in Results & merit validation.
eca.sent: Sent as {id}. ECA acknowledges by returning the same checksum; use "Check acknowledgement" on the transfer.
eca.sub: Files exchanged with the examination conducting agency. Each outbound file is validated, checksummed (SHA-256), encrypted and sent; ECA acknowledges by checksum. Copies go to the Nodal RRB and RRB/SC.
eca.title: ECA data exchange
frd.h1: Live photograph at DV compared with the application photograph; below the threshold set by the Member Secretary.

frd.h4: Name, father’s name, date of birth and ID digits match an active debar record.
frd.h5: Signature at DV differs from the signature in the application.

ret.p1: Live: two years from the last panel of the CEN, or until all court cases are closed.
ret.p2: Backup: five years from the first panel.
ret.p3: Handover: encrypted offline media with a SHA-256 manifest, signed by the RRB and the vendor; the online copy is then purged and the purge recorded in the activity log.
ret.sub: Live data for each CEN is kept for the period in the policy, then moved to backup. When the period ends, an encrypted offline package with a manifest of checksums is prepared and handed over to the RRB.
ret.title: Data retention & handover
